reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes corrosion testing methods and Mo-based passivation in high-entropy alloys and stainless steels, but provides no data on phosphonate inhibitor films on Q235 steel, their deposition, electrochemical effects, or temperature-dependent stability. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
